name: Marketing agency hero: split layout with a giant slow-rotating conic pinwheel filling the right side
notes: No photo in this one on purpose — the .pinwheel is a pure CSS conic-gradient (no image, no SVG, no JS) spun with a 34s linear infinite rotation, plus a dashed ring inside it counter-rotating at 22s for depth. Both are pure decoration built from CSS custom properties, so recoloring the target site's brand is a two-variable swap (--violet, --lime). If pulling into a real build with a photo-driven identity, either drop the photo into .hero-motion behind the pinwheel at reduced opacity, or keep it photo-free — it reads fine either way. Respects prefers-reduced-motion by killing both rotations outright rather than slowing them, since a giant frozen pinwheel still reads fine as a static graphic.
